areas.name: text_style
areas.description: Change how text is set: bold, light or other weights, italic, underline, strikethrough, capitals (all caps, uppercase, lowercase, title case), aligning the lines of a text left, center, right or justified, letter spacing and line spacing.

areas.name: size_and_shape
areas.description: Change size, turn and shape: make it bigger or smaller, larger or tinier, scale it, set the font size, rotate or turn it, flip or mirror it, round the corners or make them square.

areas.name: colour_and_brand
areas.description: Change colour and see-through: a named colour such as red or blue, a hex code, the brand kit's colours (primary, secondary, accent, background, text) and fonts (heading, body), opacity and transparency.

areas.name: arrange
areas.description: Line up, space out and order layers: align them left, center, right, top, middle or bottom, distribute or spread them evenly, bring forward or send back, move or nudge them up, down, left or right.

areas.name: layers
areas.description: Copy, duplicate, delete, remove, group, ungroup, lock, unlock, hide or show the selected layers.

text_style.name: set_text_weight
text_style.description: Make text bold, heavier, lighter or regular weight.

weight.description: How heavy the letters are; regular is normal, not bold.

text_style.name: set_text_case
text_style.description: Set text in all caps (uppercase), lowercase, title case, or back to normal case as typed.

case.description: uppercase is all caps or capitals; normal is as typed.

text_style.name: style_text
text_style.description: Turn italic, underline or strikethrough on or off.

style.description: The text style; strikethrough is crossed out.

on.description: true to add the style, false to remove it.

text_style.name: align_text
text_style.description: Align the lines of a text inside its own box: left, center, right or justified.

align.description: Where each line of the text sits in its box.

text_style.name: change_spacing
text_style.description: Loosen or tighten the space between letters (letter spacing, tracking) or between lines (line spacing, leading).

direction.description: more is looser or wider, less is tighter.

size_and_shape.name: resize
size_and_shape.description: Make the selection bigger or smaller, by a percentage when one is given; for text this is its font size.

direction.description: bigger is larger or scale up; smaller is scale down.

percent.description: How much, as a percentage, e.g. 20.

size_and_shape.name: set_font_size
size_and_shape.description: Set the font size of text to a number, in pixels or points.

size_and_shape.name: rotate
size_and_shape.description: Rotate or turn the selection by a number of degrees; negative turns it anticlockwise (counterclockwise, to the left).

size_and_shape.name: flip
size_and_shape.description: Flip or mirror the selection: horizontal swaps left and right, vertical turns it upside down.

size_and_shape.name: round_corners
size_and_shape.description: Round the corners by a radius in pixels; 0 makes them square or sharp.

colour_and_brand.name: use_brand_colour
colour_and_brand.description: Colour the selection with one of the brand kit's colours.

role.description: The brand colour's role in the kit.

colour_and_brand.name: set_colour
colour_and_brand.description: Colour the selection with a plain named colour.

colour.description: The colour's name; gray is grey.

colour_and_brand.name: set_hex_colour
colour_and_brand.description: Colour the selection with an exact hex colour code.

hex.description: The hex code with its #, e.g. #1A2B3C.

colour_and_brand.name: set_opacity
colour_and_brand.description: Set how see-through the selection is, as a percentage of opacity or of transparency.

percent.description: The percentage the request names, e.g. 50.

measure.description: opacity when the number is how solid it is, transparency when it is how see-through it is.

colour_and_brand.name: use_brand_font
colour_and_brand.description: Set text in one of the brand kit's fonts.

font.description: The brand font's role in the kit.

arrange.name: align_layers
arrange.description: Line up the selected layers along an edge or a center line; one layer lines up with its frame.

edge.description: center lines up across, middle lines up down the page.

arrange.name: distribute_layers
arrange.description: Spread the selected layers out with even gaps, across or down.

direction.description: horizontally is across, side by side; vertically is down.

arrange.name: change_layer_order
arrange.description: Bring the selection forward or send it backward a step, or all the way to the front or the back.

to.description: front is on top of everything; back is behind everything.

arrange.name: move_layers
arrange.description: Move or nudge the selection up, down, left or right by pixels.

layers.name: duplicate_layers
layers.description: Duplicate or copy the selection, the copy right above it.

layers.name: group_layers
layers.description: Group the selected layers together, or ungroup them.

layers.name: lock_layers
layers.description: Lock the selection so it cannot be changed, or unlock it.

layers.name: hide_layers
layers.description: Hide the selection, or show it again.
